title: Boston Road and Prospect Avenue neighbors: Tyree Glenn, Fats Waller
summary: Campbell recalls where he lived, local businesses, Tyree Glenn, the original Fat Man and Turner's Arcadians.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: A friend of mine has a barber shop near Boston Road, name is Daniels.
I wouldn't be a bit surprised because all of the merchants really --
Andhe's from Pittsburgh.
Really? I didn't know that.
But you know what he was telling me about Goodson -- I didn't know that Goodson was dead.
Oh, yeah and that place has been --
And they told me he left

We were talking about Fat Man, Fats Waller --
Yeah, the original Fat Man was Charlie Turner and his band was Turner's Arcadians.
That's right.
They used to be at the Arcadia Ballroom years ago.

And he played with Fats. And then, you know, he and Eddie Mallory were in partnership there with Fat Mans in the Bronx here. In fact the one in Manhattan, too. And Eddie, I bought the house that I'm living in from Eddie Mallory.
Is he alive?
No, Eddie died here a few years ago, yes, he's been gone. And so I moved up there in 1945.
